name: Plan Well
tagline: A personalized 7-day Indian meal planning web application.
overview: Plan Well is a responsive web application that generates personalized 7-day Indian meal plans based on the user's weight, state, diet preference, preferred number of meals per day, and optional protein supplement information. Users can securely sign in with Google to save, revisit, manage, and download their meal plans as professionally formatted PDF reports, providing a convenient and personalized nutrition planning experience.
